name: kb-organizer
description: Automatically analyzes the content distribution of a knowledge base, proposes personalized classification schemes, creates folders and batch-moves items into place. Runs in two modes: a full mode for knowledge bases without folders or needing reclassification, following analysis, proposal, folder creation, classification, moving and verification, and a tidying mode for scattered root-directory items, following scan, classification, move and verification. Scans the root directory with pagination, builds a content portrait with media type distribution and high-frequency keyword clustering, then generates two to three candidate schemes such as classification by application scenario, content type or platform. Builds dynamic keyword mapping rules for classification and moves items in batches of ten, keeping original path records, never deleting or overwriting, and verifying that totals match before and after.

displayDescription.en: Analyzes a knowledge base, proposes personalized classification schemes and creates folders to batch-file scattered items. Scans the root directory, builds a content portrait with media type distribution and high-frequency keyword clustering, then generates two to three candidate schemes such as classification by application scenario, content type or platform. Builds dynamic keyword mapping rules for classification and moves items in batches of ten, keeping original path records and verifying totals match, without ever deleting or overwriting existing content.
